# Pinned Zyntalic engine

Zyntalic 0.4.0, MIT licensed; source: https://github.com/kugguk2022/Zyntalic_idiom.

Bundled wheel SHA-256: `4389e91e55a97a977df4efc796a6e38706e3c15a323fb9d98dd2a58ef2696f0a`.

Install from the repository root with `python3 -m pip install atlas/vendor/zyntalic-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl`. Then `python3 atlas/build_zyntalic.py --translate` regenerates only changed source passages. The website uses precomputed translations and does not execute Python or contact a translation service.
